answer: Timed jetty boarding windows stop sybil swarms. Each alias draws one public 2-hour boarding window per day from a daily seed lottery, and the jetty only accepts task claims inside that window, so a hundred fake aliases cannot flood the same hour. A cedar-stamped public roster lists every alias with its window, and timber tally boards at each gate count claims per window so anyone can spot an alias claiming twice in one day. An alias caught outside its window loses its tasks for that day and sits out the next 7 days, and repeat offenders lose their roster slot entirely.
